nodes.label: Biglobster LLC

Exception (2026-10-02): customer deploys of bl-site-package put the customer as legal owner under Spanish law; Biglobster is not named on their legal pages.
Company data lives in biglobster/site/_data/site.json (legalName, address, registration); not copied here.
Apps that state this owner in code: FinView (frontend/src/lib/legal.ts), SocialAgenda (social_agenda/legal.py), FlyWell (apps/web/src/lib/legal.ts).

nodes.label: FinView
nodes.summary: Personal investment dashboard: multi-broker import, Spanish IRPF fiscal engine (FIFO), options monitor with LLM analysis, and geopolitical 'Ideas' signals.
details: Brokers imported: Trade Republic, DEGIRO, Interactive Brokers, ING, BBVA, eToro (PDF/CSV/XLSX parsers).
Stack: FastAPI (Python 3.12) + SQLAlchemy backend, Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript frontend (NextAuth, shadcn/ui, Recharts).
Prod: Vercel frontend + Cloud Run europe-west1 backend + Neon Postgres; backend CI/CD is a Cloud Build trigger (candidate-first deploy with rollback).
Open registration with stored terms consent; data-not-advice rule enforced in prompts and UI (2026-10-02). Owner on legal pages: Biglobster LLC.
Tests (2026-10-05): ~1420 backend pytest, 148 frontend vitest.
Absorbed OptionsAI (options agent, fiscal engine, importers) and WorldHawk (geo-intel signal layer, ported to Python 2026-06 onward).
Latest work (2026-10-05/06): options alert dedup moved to DB, generative answers persisted, reasoning off on LLM calls.

Production LLM (2026-10-10): FINVIEW_OPENROUTER_MODEL=deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash set on Cloud Run (code default stays deepseek-v4-flash). Key moved to Biglobster LLC's OpenRouter account 2026-10-09; every OpenRouter call sends provider.data_collection=deny via llm_envelope.chat().
Watch: first Zonas Clave scorer run on the new model (22:15 UTC Mon-Fri); Artifact Registry keeps only the newest 10 images (cleanup policies since 2026-10-08).

Added 2026-10-12..19: direct IBKR Flex sync with daily cron (#347/#348), sector/region/AI exposure from annual reports (#351-#357), backend token renewal via POST /auth/refresh (#344), Cloud Run revision named per build (#352), fiscal inputs loaded once per request (#342).

nodes.label: FinView frontend
nodes.summary: Next.js 16 app (dashboard, portfolio, options, Zonas Clave, Ideas/geo-intel, alt-investments, blog, legal, pricing, login/register).
details: Browser calls /api/*; Next rewrites forward to BACKEND_URL (Cloud Run). NextAuth routes stay in Next.
~100 MDX blog posts under src/app/blog (build fails if index, files and illustrations drift).
Landing page has a 'dividend garden' canvas animation that becomes a game (2026-10-02).
Merge gate: Vercel preview check must be green before merging any PR touching frontend/**.
Vercel holds only BACKEND_URL, AUTH_SECRET, public Turnstile site key and public Stripe price ids; ingestion keys live only in Cloud Run.
Session handling (2026-10): ends the session when a retried request is still 401 (#343); token renewal in the NextAuth jwt callback (#344).

nodes.label: FinView API
nodes.summary: FastAPI backend on Cloud Run: imports, transactions, fiscal boxes, portfolio, options, geo, zonas-clave, billing, auth and user data export/delete.
details: Cloud Run europe-west1, service finview-api; min=0 max=1 instances, CPU throttled; request-scoped runtime (no background workers in prod).
Schema via create_all + additive-column registry (no Alembic). Neon Postgres in prod, SQLite locally.
Image built and pushed by Cloud Build (trigger finview-api-deploy); smoke test, 0% private revision, promotion, readiness recheck, rollback.
Cron endpoints authenticated with X-Cron-Key; Turnstile verification on login/register.
Notifications: ntfy.sh, SMTP email, Telegram bot (all optional, env-driven).
OpenRouter key rotation: new Cloud Run revision with --no-traffic, diff, then update-traffic --to-latest (docs/deployment.md).

Artifact Registry repo cloud-run-source-deploy (europe-west1) keeps the newest 10 images (keep-newest-10 + delete-the-rest policies, 2026-10-08); for a manual rollback pick one of the 10 latest revisions.

POST /auth/refresh (2026-10, #344) issues a fresh token to a still-valid session; the NextAuth jwt callback renews it when fewer than 7 days remain. Candidate Cloud Run revisions are named per build, not per commit (#352).

nodes.label: FinView importers + FIFO engine
nodes.summary: Per-broker parsers (pdfplumber/openpyxl/csv) plus the cross-broker FIFO engine that produces the IRPF casillas.
details: fifo_engine.py is the most sensitive file; any historical mutation must call recalculate_fifo_from_year.
Portfolio snapshots authoritative only when ImportRecord.portfolio_snapshot_complete=true; totals fail closed on any unknown cost or price.
Importers are isolated per broker; 148 tests skip without the real broker files.

nodes.label: Options monitor agent
nodes.summary: Agent cycle Observe -> Greeks -> Analyze -> Store -> Notify -> LLM report over watchlist options chains (Yahoo, MEFF, Eurex).
details: Detects IV, put/call, skew, unusual volume and premium spikes (stateless: contract vs its own previous close since 2026-10-06).
Alert dedup stored in DB table options_alert_notifications; one push per alert episode (PR #328-#330).
LLM calls (cycle report, per-ticker report, chat) run with reasoning off (2026-10-05).
Backtest service records signals and evaluates them at checkpoints.

nodes.label: Geo-Intel ('Ideas')
nodes.summary: Turns geopolitical and natural events into market signals via a 84-rule catalogue, with an LLM analyst and a learning loop; ported from WorldHawk.
details: 9 ingest sources: seismic (USGS), EONET+GDACS events, NASA FIRMS fires, maritime AIS, meteo (Windy), flights (adsb.lol), GDELT 15-min exports, OFAC actions, Federal Register.
Country layer (2026-10-04): 33 country funds + local companies; allowed_symbols gate on both LLM paths.
Learning loop (2026-09-25): confidence_mod derived from rule accuracy; 4-hourly audit re-rates active signals.
Generative thesis for salient unmatched events: <=3 per request, answers persisted in geo_generative_answers (2026-10-05).
Ideas are shared by all accounts: one system owner runs the cycle, every reader sees its rows.

nodes.label: Zonas Clave
nodes.summary: Support/resistance engine (pure technical analysis) whose proximity candidates are scored by an LLM and fire technical signals.
details: Trigger layer of the signal architecture: Zonas Clave fires, Options Monitor executes with PUT/CALL, Ideas carries the thesis.
Alert gate calibrated from outcomes: lowest floor with >=30 measured and >=55% hits, else 70 (2026-09-25).
Daily cycle also refreshes ECB, FRED and CNMV reference data.

nodes.label: geo-intel-cycle (hourly)
nodes.summary: Cloud Scheduler job POSTing /api/geo/cron (0 * * * * UTC).
details: Hourly since 2026-10-01 (was */30, earlier */10); GDELT reads the last 2 hours so a missed cycle loses nothing.
Authenticated with X-Cron-Key header (FINVIEW_CRON_SECRET); attempt-deadline 1800s, no retries; endpoint runs synchronously.
The Cloud Build rollout pauses and then resumes all four jobs; the build fails if any does not return to ENABLED.

nodes.label: geo-intel-audit (4-hourly)
nodes.summary: Cloud Scheduler job POSTing /api/geo/audit (0 */4 * * * UTC).
details: Checkpoints, live re-rating and rule learning; created 2026-09-25.
Authenticated with X-Cron-Key header (FINVIEW_CRON_SECRET); attempt-deadline 1800s, no retries; endpoint runs synchronously.
The Cloud Build rollout pauses and then resumes all four jobs; the build fails if any does not return to ENABLED.

nodes.label: options-agent-cycle (30 min)
nodes.summary: Cloud Scheduler job POSTing /api/options/agent/cron (5,35 7-22 * * 1-5 UTC).
details: Market hours only (EU+US); every 30 min since 2026-10-01 (was */15) to fit Cloud Run free tier.
Authenticated with X-Cron-Key header (FINVIEW_CRON_SECRET); attempt-deadline 1800s, no retries; endpoint runs synchronously.
The Cloud Build rollout pauses and then resumes all four jobs; the build fails if any does not return to ENABLED.

Moved from minute 0/30 to 5 and 35 with two retries (PR #344): at :00 the tick hit the single instance during the geo cycle and Cloud Run answered 429 three times in a month, losing the cycle. Earlier detail "no retries" no longer holds.

nodes.label: zonas-clave-cycle (daily)
nodes.summary: Cloud Scheduler job POSTing /api/zonas-clave/cron (15 22 * * 1-5 UTC).
details: Daily after the NY close; also refreshes ECB/FRED/CNMV once.
Authenticated with X-Cron-Key header (FINVIEW_CRON_SECRET); attempt-deadline 1800s, no retries; endpoint runs synchronously.
The Cloud Build rollout pauses and then resumes all four jobs; the build fails if any does not return to ENABLED.

Supersedes the earlier plan to move WorldHawk to Zeabur.

nodes.label: SocialAgenda
nodes.summary: AI-powered social event calendar: discovers events from the web, per-event chat, email reminders, ICS export, social features.
details: Flask 3 (Python 3.11), SQLAlchemy + Alembic, Postgres in prod (SQLite locally and in tests); CI workflow runs the suite on SQLite and Postgres.
Served at socialagenda.biglobster.top (DNS at Namecheap pointing straight at Zeabur, no Cloudflare proxy as of 2026-10-03); app answers Alt-Svc: clear because Zeabur HTTP/3 stalled Safari.
agenda.experiencianatural.com (Cloudflare-proxied, 2026-09-27) was detached 2026-10-03 with no redirect.
UI language English, 'Pastel & Stickers' design system, public landing with an animal catch game (2026-10-02), 18+ consent on every sign-up path.
Legal pages (/about, /legal/*) owned by Biglobster LLC; fonts and FullCalendar self-hosted.

LLM (2026-10-09): dedicated SocialAgenda key on Biglobster LLC's OpenRouter account; production LLM_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-120b, LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL=xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash on the Zeabur web service. Every OpenRouter call sends provider.data_collection=deny. The scheduler service does not call OpenRouter; after a key change the web service needs a restart (client cached per process).

nodes.label: SocialAgenda web service
nodes.summary: Zeabur 'web' service: gunicorn Flask app (RUN_SCHEDULER=0) serving UI, JSON API, magic-link auth, calendar feeds and search wizard.
details: Same Docker image as the scheduler; differs by env (WEB_CONCURRENCY=2, RUN_SCHEDULER=0). Image includes Chromium for Playwright.
Magic-link login via Brevo, optional Turnstile captcha, rate limiting; superuser password only seeds (2026-09-24).
Emailed links built from BASE_URL, never the request host; client IP from CF-Connecting-IP only when the hop is Cloudflare.

nodes.label: SocialAgenda scheduler service
nodes.summary: Zeabur 'scheduler' service: same image with RUN_SCHEDULER=1, runs the reminder and security background daemons.
details: Single dedicated process so alerts are not duplicated across gunicorn workers.
Daemons must not be blocked by synchronous I/O.

nodes.label: Event discovery agent
nodes.summary: Search -> LLM extraction -> scoring pipeline over web search, followed organizers and custom RSS feeds; also per-user auto feed discovery.
details: Sources run in parallel threads: Tavily web search (ddgs fallback), Meetup/Eventbrite/Facebook/Instagram links, RSS/HTML feeds; Playwright scraping for hard pages.
LLM via OpenRouter: default nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free, fallback openai/gpt-oss-120b; every call through llm.complete() with timeouts.
All outbound fetches of uncontrolled URLs go through safe_http.safe_get() (SSRF guard).
All event text stored in English; datetimes stored as UTC ISO text.

nodes.label: Reminder alert loop
nodes.summary: calendar_agent background loop that sends due event reminder emails; each alert is claimed atomically so it cannot send twice.
details: Configurable minutes-before offsets per user; runs only in the scheduler service.

nodes.label: Security scan and cleanup
nodes.summary: security_agent daily scanner/cleanup daemon (advisory-locked); also deletes unconfirmed landing searches after 7 days.
details: Retention promised on the privacy page is enforced here.

nodes.label: FlyWell
nodes.summary: Business-class flight-deal monitor: discovers fares, scores them deterministically against route history, alerts the operator on Telegram; public free beta shows one deal.
details: Next.js web + Python fli service + Postgres on a single Zeabur project (flywell) on the Frankfurt dedicated server; live at flywell.biglobster.top.
Discovery by self-hosted fli (Google Flights, no key, self-throttled); confirmation by SerpApi (250 free searches/month).
Scoring is deterministic (no LLM): price anomaly, historical percentile, savings, stops, duration, cabin, confidence; alert price ceiling per profile (2026-09-30).
Free accounts see one deal and no operator data (2026-10-04); public face with airport landing game, /about and /legal/* owned by Biglobster LLC (2026-10-02).
Monorepo: apps/web, apps/fli-service, packages/{db,shared,normalization,flight-providers,deal-engine,jobs,notifications,config}; ~1009 tests; CI is CircleCI.
Prod sign-up 503 fixed 2026-10-05 (migration 0005 applied).

nodes.label: flywell-web
nodes.summary: Next.js dashboard + API route handlers + cron webhooks + public pages (sign-in with airport game, /about, /legal/*).
details: Single long-lived Node process on Zeabur; route policy in src/server/route-policy.ts; Drizzle ORM over Postgres.
Free-beta sign-ups (FREE_BETA_SIGNUPS); operator signs in at /login?operator.
Health check configured in the Zeabur dashboard to avoid deploy gaps (2026-10-03).

nodes.label: flywell-fli
nodes.summary: Internal-only Python/FastAPI wrapper around the 'fli' (PyPI 'flights') library; discovery data provider with a headless-Chromium transport.
details: No public domain by design; called only by flywell-web over the Zeabur internal network.
Sorts CHEAPEST, FLI_TOP_N=3 in prod; throttled (8 searches/h, 400 page loads/day, 45 s pause) to stay under Google's abuse detection.
FLI_TRANSPORT=auto uses headless Chromium after Google started gating its RPC behind a browser-signed header (2026-10-01).
Python (not fli-js) because curl_cffi impersonates a real browser TLS fingerprint.

nodes.label: Deal engine + jobs
nodes.summary: Pure scoring/statistics/confidence/lifecycle logic (packages/deal-engine) and discovery/confirmation/recheck orchestration (packages/jobs).
details: Scoring weights and thresholds are data in packages/config; confidence bands widen as observations accrue.
Search targets rotate dates after each answered search (3-day step, slot windows, 3 stay lengths; 2026-10-01).
Quota guards protect SerpApi budget; alert queue with retry.

nodes.label: FlyWell discovery cron
nodes.summary: cron-job.org job POSTing /api/cron/discovery on a 3-hour cadence (UTC).
details: Cadence 45 1,4,7,10,13,16,19,22 UTC since 2026-10-01 (was twice daily); must stay on UTC or it collides with recheck.
Protected by CRON_SHARED_SECRET; an in-flight run dies with the old container on redeploy.

nodes.label: FlyWell recheck cron
nodes.summary: cron-job.org job POSTing /api/cron/recheck (documented twice daily at 11:15 and 23:15 UTC).
details: Offset from discovery on purpose; schedule per docs/operations.md may have changed with the 2026-10-01 discovery cadence (not re-verified).

nodes.label: ChatMemo
nodes.summary: Self-hosted AI chat workspace (fork of Chatbot UI) with a persistent cross-provider memory built from imported conversations, including Claude Code sessions.
details: Next.js 15 + React 19 + TypeScript + Supabase (Postgres/Auth/Storage) + Tailwind + shadcn/ui; deployed on Vercel.
Memory sources (summaries.source): claude (Claude.ai), claude_code, copilot, chatgpt, perplexity, other; Claude Code became its own source 2026-10-01.
Memory block injected into every provider chat route; three layers (baseline blob, relevance search, trigger-gated full transcripts) sized by a context budget.
Chat providers: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Groq, Perplexity, Azure, OpenRouter, Ollama, custom endpoints.
Gate is local (husky pre-push: type-check + jest) plus Vercel build; the only workflow in the repo is upstream-watch.

OpenRouter key (2026-10-09): dedicated chatmemo key on Biglobster LLC's account, from the OPENROUTER_API_KEY Vercel variable (redeploy after editing); serves summaries and /api/chat/openrouter; no closed-weight Anthropic/Google/OpenAI models on that account yet.

Security/backup (2026-10-07): nightly backup now dumps as the read-only chatmemo_backup role through the pooler (SELECT on summaries and user_lessons); storage-delete functions locked down (audit M5, key read from Vault, anon/authenticated cannot run it) and the cleanup key sent in the apikey header.
Backup heartbeat: after each verified dump scripts/backup-chatmemo.sh updates a secret gist (time and size only); Hermes's incident sweep reads it hourly and alerts after ~50h without a beat.

nodes.label: ChatMemo web app
nodes.summary: Next.js App Router app: chat UI, one API route per provider, memory/timeline/import/export routes.
details: Memory-first chat UI (2026-09-30): report names matched entries, source chips, timeline.
Service worker caches no responses; CSP img-src limits answer images to own origins and the Supabase project.
Summaries via OpenRouter openai/gpt-oss-120b with provider data_collection deny.

Storage-delete functions locked down 2026-10-07 (audit M5, #72): key and URL moved to Supabase Vault, EXECUTE revoked from anon/authenticated; cleanup uses a dedicated secret key sent in the apikey header (#74). Storage bucket is empty (never used).

nodes.label: Memory system
nodes.summary: summaries table + injector, relevance search, full-conversation retrieval, lessons document and context budget.
details: DB trigger derives kind/source/title/occurred_at from content so every writer is classified.
Memory is untrusted text: block tags are neutralised and the instructions say sections are data, never instructions.

Backups (2026-10-07, #71): nightly LaunchAgent runs scripts/backup-chatmemo.sh as read-only role chatmemo_backup (SELECT on summaries and user_lessons) through the session pooler with TLS; verified pg_dump; macOS notification on failure. Before that the job had silently never run since 2026-05-28.
Heartbeat (#73): after each verified dump the script rewrites a secret gist (time and size only); the Hermes incident sweep alerts when it is older than ~50h or unreadable.

nodes.label: Session sync hooks
nodes.summary: Laptop and cloud scripts that push Claude Code and Copilot sessions (and other imports) to ChatMemo's import API.
details: npm run setup:sync registers Stop and SessionEnd hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json and writes ~/.chatmemo/config.json (import token + URL, no DB key).
Watcher/import scripts plus a Claude Code cloud hook served from public/hooks/chatmemo-cloud-sync.mjs; transcripts are cleaned and credentials redacted before posting.
.chatmemo-nosync opts a directory out; excludeProjects in config.

nodes.label: BigLobster (biglobster.top)

details: Since PR #248 (2026-06-04) all agents, COO, CRM, Telegram bot and LLM calls were removed and archived; operations moved to Hermes.
Stateless Node server (no DB, no bot, no LLM): Dockerfile builds Eleventy then ships _site + src; Zeabur auto-deploys on push to main.
Sells AI automation subscriptions and agent rentals to freelancers and SMBs; apps directory lists SocialAgenda and FlyWell.
Flagship of bl-site-package: a parity rule requires porting improvements to bl-site-package in the same session.
Stripe code is kept but routes were removed (PR #508, 2026-09-13) while a merchant-of-record application is under review.

Oct 2026: IndexNow ping after each deploy (static key file in web/), llms.txt lists most-viewed articles (Umami 28 d), YouTube API Services declared in privacy/terms and YouTube channel link in the footer, pricing/agents-for-rent now sell Product Guide Writer and Product Sheet Writer.

nodes.label: BigLobster web server

details: CSP, HSTS in prod, www->apex redirect, in-memory rate limiting.
/admin and /panel 302 to HERMES_PANEL_URL (Hermes operations panel).
/api/knowledge serves business info plus blog frontmatter read from source; the bl-site-package twin endpoint is for an external WhatsApp bot, biglobster's consumer was not verified.
Two CSPs must be edited together (header in src/web.js and meta in base.njk).

Legal identity (Biglobster LLC) and company data in site/_data/site.json.
site/apps.html and en/apps.html still link agenda.experiencianatural.com for Social Agenda (detached 2026-10-03).
Agent pages carry a YouTube video block fed by site/_data/videosAgentes.json (PR #698); episode videos for Content Gap Hunter added; English BIG landing and video links on /big.html.

Infographics: one 800-wide canvas, validated by hermes-sandbox infographic/validate_infographic.py.

Site key served at runtime from /api/turnstile-key; verification is OFF unless both keys are set (/health reports it).

details: Express + SQLite (better-sqlite3) + Eleventy 3; setup wizard at /setup; package version 1.27.0 (see later lines).
Customer-facing Spanish docs (INSTRUCCIONES-CLIENTE, DEPLOY, RELEASE) are treated as published.

A customer's saved ai_model wins (Shoroban keeps its own). Do not change the default again without a decision.

nodes.label: bl-site-package server + panel
nodes.summary: Express server (src/server.js) with panel, setup wizard, blog/contact/reservations/B2B APIs and SQLite store.
details: Every async route wrapped in asyncHandler (Node 22 exits on unhandled rejection).
Panel login and contact form protected by Turnstile when configured; RENTAL_AUTOMATION_KEY lets Hermes agents bypass the captcha via X-Automation-Key.
Email via SMTP settings (SMTP_HOST etc.); passenger-startup.cjs supports Passenger hosts.
Serves a 404 page built from the site template (src/not-found.js, 1.27.0). GET /api/knowledge/search?q= (Bearer KNOWLEDGE_API_TOKEN) gives the WhatsApp bot real products per turn (1.25.0-1.25.1).

details: Introduced v1.8.5 (PR #83) after Shoroban's ~14.5k-page in-process rebuild froze the API for ~30s after each owned sheet write.

nodes.label: AI marketing agent
nodes.summary: Panel assistant that drafts posts and page content through OpenRouter using the customer's own key; default model openai/gpt-oss-120b (paid).
details: Chat route rate-limited to protect the customer's BYOK credit; agents can publish posts and product sheets directly (no review gate).
Default model is paid openai/gpt-oss-120b since 2026-10-09 (was free gpt-oss-20b); free models are a fallback on 429/402. Model is chosen in the panel (ai_model row); CONTENT_AGENT_MODEL is not read.

nodes.label: Liderpapel catalogue sync
nodes.summary: node-cron job (default 0 6 * * *) that syncs a distributor product feed over sFTP and re-prices with the shop margin.
details: Shoroban's catalogue is ~14.5k products from Liderpapel; feed owns cost/stock/specs, we own product_content.
Mode sftp or local fixtures (LIDERPAPEL_SYNC_MODE).

nodes.label: Privacy retention purge
nodes.summary: Daily scheduler deleting contact messages after 24 months and orders after 6 years, as promised on the legal pages.

nodes.label: Fleet manifest + fleet-check
nodes.summary: fleet/manifest.json lists every deployment (reference + customers); scripts/fleet-check.mjs compares each deploy's version to main.

nodes.label: Shoroban production site
nodes.summary: First customer deployment: catalogue shop site on its own Plesk (Passenger) host, updated through the panel with no SSH.
details: Was on v1.8.11 on 2026-09-25 (updated via the panel, no SSH); Turnstile active on panel login; dedicated Hermes profile 'shoroban' and its own OpenRouter key.
Catalogue of ~14.5k products synced from Liderpapel; Hermes writes posts, product sheets and infographics here.

nodes.label: grow-shop.com
nodes.summary: Domain-sale landing page for grow-shop.com plus a micro-API that emails purchase offers.
details: Two repos (grow-shop-landing, grow-shop-api), both on one Zeabur project (grow-shop), auto-deploy from main.
Also the first Hermes customer profile ('grow-shop') with its own Telegram forum topic (2026-06-06 multi-tenancy).
README notes ownership by Biglobster LLC (GitHub organization BiglobsterLLC) after repo transfer (grow-shop-landing 44fd898).

nodes.label: grow-shop landing
nodes.summary: Single index.html (inline CSS/JS, no build) selling the domain with an offer form.
details: Form posts to grow-shop-api /api/submit-offer; Cloudflare Turnstile widget on the form.

nodes.label: grow-shop API
nodes.summary: Single-file Express 4 API (Node 20): GET /health, POST /api/submit-offer sending an owner notification and a visitor auto-reply.
details: Verifies the Turnstile token before sending (commit 3d904a1); email via Resend using a verified sender domain.
No tests, no build step; intentionally minimal.

nodes.label: heclient (Agentic)
nodes.summary: Scaffold for 'Agentic': a control plane that provisions a dedicated Hermes coding agent per customer on Zeabur, connected to GitHub and Telegram.
details: Next.js 16 / React 19 / Tailwind with SQLite (better-sqlite3) customer registry; 6-step onboarding wizard.
Only commit is the initial scaffold (2026-06-06); local git repo with no remote; PLAN.md roadmap items for Vercel deploy, dashboard auth and billing are unchecked.
No mention in decisions or memories; treat as dormant.

nodes.label: Provisioning API
nodes.summary: POST /api/provision creates a Zeabur project and service from the hermes-sandbox GHCR image, sets env vars, redeploys and seeds SOUL.md via /api/delegate.
details: GET /api/status/:serviceId returns the customer record and health check.
Env names: ZEABUR_API_TOKEN, ZEABUR_OWNER_ID, GHCR_USERNAME, GHCR_PAT, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, EXA_API_KEY.

nodes.label: OfflinePics (MyTrove)
nodes.summary: Local-first desktop photo library (renamed MyTrove 2026-08-16): copies iPhone and legacy originals into a user-owned, verifiable library outside iCloud.
details: GPL-3.0 fork of Lap (julyx10/lap); Tauri 2 + Rust backend, Vue 3 + Vite frontend, local ONNX models.
Managed import with BLAKE3 dedup, portable manifests, exact-path catalog indexing, interrupted-import recovery, OSXPhotos adapter for Apple Photos migration.
Backup design: manual immutable recovery snapshot into a Google Drive for Desktop folder; optional one-way Google Photos viewing copy (no direct API).
Status: review build, version 0.3.0, not approved for the full ~200-290 GB migration; releases/CI via GitHub workflows (mac/windows/homebrew).
Mobile viewing plan prefers a curated Google Photos copy over a custom iPhone client (workspace decision 2026-08-16).

nodes.label: MyTrove desktop app
nodes.summary: Tauri 2 app (src-tauri Rust + src-vite Vue) for browsing, importing and cataloguing the managed library.
details: Local only: no account service, photo cloud or analytics; optional network use (e.g. map tiles) disclosed in PRIVACY.md.

nodes.label: Managed import + recovery snapshot
nodes.summary: Verified import engine (staging journal, atomic commit, dedup) and the manual recovery snapshot of Originals/Renditions/Manifests.
details: Snapshot written to a user-chosen Google Drive for Desktop folder; the app never claims knowledge of remote upload state.

Deliberately names no builder or links; Google Fonts loaded from the page.
Its animation-plus-game idea was reused for FlyWell and SocialAgenda public faces (2026-10-02).
The Zeabur project 'experiencianatural' was 'born migrated' to the server (workspace decision 2026-10-02).

nodes.label: FACTURAS
nodes.summary: Local Python tooling that rebuilds lost 2025 invoices (marked DUPLICADO, PrestaShop #CU numbering) for the owner's shop company from orders, picking lists and bank evidence.
details: preparar.py builds data/pedidos.json and a review CSV; generar.py renders HTML to PDF with headless Chrome; standard library only plus pdftotext.
Tax rules confirmed 2026-09-30: PT 23%, Canarias 0%, else 21%; destination taken from carrier invoices; every invoice must total the charged amount.
Batches: January 2025 (#CU082631-#CU082814) and lote2 Feb-Jun (#CU082815-#CU084204) generated; batch 3 waits for inputs; numbering vs real invoices still open.
Folder is untracked inside the workspace repo (data never committed); contains customer and bank data, none copied here.

2026-10-08: the website's buyer exported the original invoices (2021-06 to 2025-06); corregir_originales.py swaps only the logo and footer contact lines in the PDFs. If later parts cover Jan-Jun 2025 the reconstructed duplicates are superseded.

nodes.label: FinView IBKR direct sync
nodes.summary: Direct Interactive Brokers connection via the Flex Web Service: pulls full account history one calendar year per request and imports it through the same path as an uploaded CSV.
details: Added 2026-10 (PRs #347, #348). User supplies a read-only Flex token and query ID; token encrypted at rest with Fernet (FINVIEW_CREDENTIALS_KEY; unset closes the feature), never returned by the API or included in the data export.
Resumable run stored on broker_connections; services in backend/services/ibkr_flex.py and broker_sync.py. Synced imports do not spend the upload quota.

Daily sync: POST /api/brokers/cron (X-Cron-Key) runs broker_sync.sync_all round-robin over every active connection under a 300 s budget; Cloud Scheduler job ibkr-sync-daily, added to the rollout SCHEDULER_JOBS.
Frontend: IBKR connection card on the import tab, hidden when the backend has no credentials key.

nodes.label: FinView sector/region/AI exposure
nodes.summary: Spreads each position's value over the sectors, regions and AI exposure its issuer's own latest annual report implies, shown on /portfolio.
details: Added 2026-10 (PRs #351, #353, #356, #357). US issuers read from the latest 10-K XBRL on SEC EDGAR; all others from the ESEF segment note (ISIN to LEI via GLEIF, filings via filings.xbrl.org), amounts copied by an LLM and stored only if they add up to the tagged total and appear verbatim.
PR #356: totals for banks (gross margin), insurers and property companies; report year taken from its facts. PR #357: each check stores a reader version so a reader fix invalidates cached answers.
Uncovered stocks are estimated 100% by ISIN country and Yahoo Finance sector (equities only, labelled "estimado" in the UI), cached in listing_profiles (30 days).
AI exposure: counts AI mentions in the report (up to three verbatim quotes) plus an industry AI index built offline from open data (Eloundou et al. 2024 scores weighted by BLS OEWS staffing).
